generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
In the Sanctioned Estimate, the item rates are showing inclusive of all applicable taxes but it is to be noted that rates are exclusive of taxes (GST).

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 CONTINUED FOR 2026-27 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24 (As per Government order FD 417 EXP-12 2024 dated 09/08/2024). Therefore, amount put to Tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. KPPP-PORTAL format has No Options to add GST Separately at stage of Draft Tender Schedule Process for Over All amount put to Tender, tender has been inviting through an Option with INCLUSIVE. But the item wise rates do not include GST. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. Hence the bidder has to quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit a declaration which is duly signed by the bidder along with their tender proposal.
The contractor shall submit the details of the technical staff employed by him.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public procurement portal
Royalty on construction materials and other applicable taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incidents happen on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts labor, hire charges of machinery equipment etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the concerned Executive Engineer, PWD Division, during office hours on all working days.
Contractor should strictly follow the prevailing rules of the labour act.
The Tenderer should furnish all the necessary original documents mentioned above to the Executive engineer
The intending bidders are requested to note that they should abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the bid documents and further orders thereon.
Contractor has to upload the valid EPF registration copy.

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit an MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise the Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract

As per Karnataka state Government order LD.300.LET.2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW.134.BMS.2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1 Percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
Materials like bitumen steel cement etc required for the work shell be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work
The Defect Liability period for this work is 1 years after completion of work
Work shall be carried out according to relevant IS/IRC codes specifications depending on type of work.
The tenderer should be a KPWD registered Contractor -Class IV and Above Registration and the tenderer should submit registration certificate.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e.2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 3.2(a) Achieved in at least ONE financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs.8.45 Lakhs, (in all classes of Civil Engineering Construction works only) Balance sheet & Profit & Loss Account indicating contract receipts issued by the competent accountant / Authority with UDIN number
This Work is reserved for contractors belonging to CAT-IIA. Only contractors belonging to CAT-IIA need submit the tenders for this work.

The tenderer shall upload the scanned copy of the current CAT-IIA Certificate issued in the prescribed format by the Competent Authority, through KPPP-portal along with the tender. The original copy of the same shall be produced for verification at the time of Tender Scrutiny.

The tenderer shall upload the scanned copy of the Domiscile Certificate for having been residing in the Karnataka State for not less than 10 years, issued by the Competent Authority, through KPPP-portal along with the tender. The original copy of the same shall be produced for verification at the time of Tender Scrutiny.
Tenders not complying with above conditions, will not be considered for Tender Evaluation.

itemList.description: Clearing  &  grubbing  road  land  including  vegetation,  bushes, shrubs, saplings by using weed cutter / minor equipment. ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

Manual Means -
Earth work in surface excavation for stripping, seating of bund, Road way, by manual  means  for  lowering  &  leveling  the  ground  for  all   works  other  than foundation & depth in all kinds of soil not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out,   shoring, strutting, barricading, caution  lights,  removal  of  stumps  and  other  deleterious  matter  including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting &  stacking the selected  earth for reuse in a radius of  50 m and lift upto
1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage & other appurtenances required to complete the work. ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

Providing   and   fixing   Chlorinated   Polyvinyl   Chloride   (CPVC)   pipes, having thermal stability for hot & cold water supply including all CPVC plain & brass threaded fittings This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step CPVC solvent cement, trenching, refilling & testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge. External work - 25 mm nominal dia Pipes ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

Providing  and  fixing  Sewer  (SWR)  pipes,  including  all    fittings,  This includes  jointing  of  pipes  &  fittings  with  one  step    solvent  cement, trenching,  refilling  &  testing  of  joints  complete  as  per  direction  of Engineer in Charge. - 110mm nominal dia pipes ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

to IS:8931 ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

Repairs to existing aluminium partition including Glass,board, lock, handle, beading etc cost of all material,labour, complete as per specifications. ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

Cleaning  of  terrace/loft  water  storage  tank  (inside  surface  area)  upto 2000  litre  capacity  at  all  heights  with  coconut  brushes,  duster  etc., removal of silt, rubbish from the tank and cleaning the tank with fresh water  disinfecting  with  bleaching  powder  @  0.5gm  per  litre  capacity of tank including marking the date of cleaning on the side of tank body with the help of stencil and paint and disposing of malba all complete as per  direction  of  Engineer-in-Charge.  (The  old  date  already  written  on tank should be removed with paint remover or black paint and if date is not written with the stencil or old date is not removed deduction will be made @ Rs. 0.10 per litre) (if during cleaning any GI fittings or ball cock is damaged that is to be repaired by contractor at his own cost and nothing extra will be paid on this account) ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

Providing and fixing factory made ISI marked steel glazed doors, windows and ventilators, side /top /centre hung, with beading and all members such as F7D,F4B, K11 B and K12 B etc. complete of standard rolled steel sections,  joints  mitred  and  flash  butt  welded  and  sash  bars  tenoned and riveted, including providing and fixing of hinges, pivots, including priming coat of approved steel primer, but excluding the cost of other fittings, complete all as per approved design, (sectional weight of only steel members shall be measured for payment).
Fixing  with  15x3  mm  lugs  10  cm  long  embedded  in  cement concrete block 15x10x10 cm of C.C. 1:3:6 (1 Cement : 3 coarse sand : 6 graded stone aggregate 20 mm nominal size)  including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

Painting   with   synthetic   enamel   paint   of   approved   brand   and manufacture  to  give  an  even  shade  :Two  coats  on  new  work   after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

Cleaning and desilting of gully trap chamber, including removal of rubbish mixed with earth etc. and disposal  of same, all  as per  the direction of Engineer-in- charge. ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead

supply and Installation of  Multicell Standing Seam polycarbonate panels having flux 7.0 as per EN 16153 & EN ISO 10077-2. For min joints, panel shall be 1000 - 1200 mm wide with standing seam on both sides. Panels shall have minimum six-seven layers with Truss bridge design for higher flexibility  and  strength.  The  system  shall  be  secured  using  suitable connectors with double tooth grip lock locking mechanism and fixed on purlin(to be paid separately)  having a pull out load of min 7000N tested as  per  ISO  6892-1998  and  IS  1608-2005.  Panels  must  satisfy   impact test as per IS 14443-97 shall show no sign of breakage which have been exposed to UV for 500 Hours (min) as per ASTM G 155. Panels shall have Yellowness Index of not more than 15 units as per ASTM D 1925 when tested  on  a  sample  exposed  to  UV  for  500  Hours  as  per  ASTM  G  155. Panel shall be closed at the end with additional Aluminium U profile as required. All aluminium should be factory finished / mill finished. Panel shall be fixed over MS structural steel / MS purlin (to be paid separately) conforming to the details in the specifications as per direction of Engineer in charge of work.
12mm  Thick  Multicell  Polycarbonate  Panel  having  U  value  of  2.5 W/m2 K (max) ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials with hire charges of machinery and equipments, with all lead
